what: Kid App background Spotify, OBD, and other-app connections stay idle unless that feature is open. /test/ only. index.html untouched.
probe: headless Chrome, evaluateOnNewDocument wraps setInterval/setTimeout/fetch/WebSocket/BroadcastChannel/geolocation/bluetooth/serial/postMessage and deviceorientation/devicemotion. One browser. Wait about 4.5s after domcontentloaded.

world.html start card and driving.network: one finished fetch of world/warm-manifest.json, no Spotify, no OBD, no WebSocket

jr.html menu, saved Spotify token.network: POST https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token (refresh) even though the menu is idle

after.world.html start card and driving, ?perf: idle iv 0 · ch 0 · net 0 · sensor 0 · tilt on. warm-manifest.json fetched once and finished (status 200, not live). No page errors.
after.world-split.html: same: iv 0, ch 0, net 0, tilt on
after.jr.html menu, saved Spotify token: idle iv 0 · ch 0 · net 0 · sensor 0 · tilt on. No Spotify request.
after.jr.html road, saved Spotify token: idle iv 500ms,20ms,16ms · ch 0 · net 0 · sensor 0 · tilt on. 500ms is the road card tilt-status text, 20ms is the local ROAD beat clock, 16ms is the practice sim. No Spotify request.
after.jr.html dashboard, saved Spotify token: idle iv 20ms,4000ms,200ms,16ms · ch 0 · net 0 · sensor devicemotion · tilt on. Spotify token refresh runs only because the dashboard music player is open and the saved source is Spotify.
after.paint studio inside Neon World: opening it starts a 200ms wait and zdash-neonpaint plus zdash-wallgraffiti. Closing it returns to iv 0, ch 0.
after.neon-paint.html: channels open because that page is the paint feature. The car-wait interval stops once the car is ready.
after.fly3.html: one 500ms tilt-button refresh. No channels, no network.
after.dance-stage.html: iv 0, ch 0 while the stage is open. A channel is created only when a dance is saved.

left_running: Tilt (deviceorientation) on Neon World and the kid games.
One finished local fetch of world/warm-manifest.json at Neon World startup.
ROAD's local beat clock and practice sim, and the road card's tilt-status refresh.
Dashboard music clock, Spotify poll, and phone motion only while the dashboard tile is open.
Phone-link, OBD bluetooth/serial, and battery read only after the user starts that feature.
?perf=1 paints its own 500ms line. That timer is absent without the flag.
